name: perplexity_search_web
description: Search the web using Perplexity AI and filter results by recency

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The search query to find information about

arguments.name: recency
arguments.description: Filter results by how recent they are. Options: 'day' (last 24h), 'week' (last 7 days), 'month' (last 30 days), 'year' (last 365 days). Defaults to 'month'.
